description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named CustomerController which provides CRUD operations and other customer-related functionalities within a banking application. It handles HTTP requests for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting customers, and fetching their account balances.

classes.name: CustomerController
classes.description: A REST controller exposing CRUD endpoints for customer management in a banking application.

methods.name: createCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer using details received in the request body.

methods.name: getCustomers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all customers.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Fetches details of a single customer identified by customerId.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Updates information of an existing customer identified by customerId.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer identified by customerId.

methods.name: getBalancesForCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves balances for all accounts linked to a specific customer.
